Direction for question:

Logix Soft Ltd. is a software company that specialises in Internet Banking Solutions. Currently, Logix Soft Ltd. has undertaken three projects for 3 banks, viz., Citybank, Axes Bank and AMN Abro Bank. Being a start-up, this company has a very small team of programmers. Some of these programmers are involved in more than one project and every programmer is involved in at least one of the three projects.

• The number of programmers involved in the Axes Bank project alone is twice the number of programmers involved in all the three projects.

• The number of programmers involved in the Citybank project alone is four less than three times the number of programmers involved in all the three projects.

• The number of programmers involved in the AMN Abro Bank project alone is four more than the number of programmers involved in all the three projects.

• 24 programmers are involved in the Citybank project.

• Some of the programmers are involved in exactly 2 projects and these numbers for the various possible combinations, are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 (in some order).

• Ten programmers involved in the Citybank project are also involved in at least one more project.

After the withdrawal of programmers, as indicated in the previous question, some new programmers joined the company. Each of them was allotted only one project in a manner such that the number of programmers involved in each of the three projects became identical.3


So, the minimum number of programmers who newly joined the company is equal to:
